translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content: Jiszs Tulz-mop Mz Nzbzngr
Mz nourla kxtopwz mz Sade, olvz kcng nzvzng mz butqbr, sc tzrtwzneng dalr nzaelungr nrkrdrtq Jiszs.
Nzvzbzng, nzmcpelr rplz kc tzapqbrtrngr mrkc tzdwakitrpz, nzalqlipxpe.
Zbz nzdwatrpzng, a' trnzmclru nrkrdrtq Kxetu Jiszs.
Mzli kc tztu-ngrpwzlr mrkc, drtwrdr otrblamrtx-pnzngr mz da lc, nzpwrkilvc-ngrdr enjrl nzling, sc tztupebzng badr. Lrpzdr pnapr x nzobq-krdr nzapulr nzobqkr ncblo.
Olvz kcng nzmwxlrtx-ngrdr enjrl kcng, x nzobqtxong mz drtc'. A' enjrl kcng nzrpibzlr kx, “?Memule tqrtangrti-ngrnamu kxlu mz mzlir kxnzbzpeng?
Trmncu mrka. Tulzpe-mop. Nadctipx drtwrmu da kc tqpi-pnzbzle bamu mzli kc tqmnc-ngrde Gzlili.
Murde rpile kx na-aprcbz nide mz mq kxdrka'-ngrng. X natqlvztr mz kros, x mz zbq kratq, sc tqtulzpe-mop.”
Zbz olvz kcng sc tzdctipx ate drtwrdr natqdeng.
Nzyzlumqng Jerusalem, x sc tzpipebzlr da lcng amrlx mz aposol nedeng kcng nzpnu-esz'-nrade-esz', badr leplz neng Jiszs amrlx.
Drtq olvz kcng deseleng: Mxri kc Makdala, x Joana, x Mxri lxede Jemes. Nidr badr olvz kc-kzng tzvzng badr mz butqbr kc, nzpibzlr da lcng mz aposol neng Jiszs.
A' aposol kcng nzrpilr kx da kc tzpibzlr olvz kcng tropxpuu da, x trnzlxngitipwzlru natqdr.
A' Pita dwatxpx x sc tqvopebz mz butqbr kc. Yrngzobz, obqtrpz, x mcpele lrpz kcng tzbxti nrkrdrtq kc. A' trpnz-moungr da. Zbz yzlutx mou mrkc tqmnc-ngrde, drtwrde otrblamrtx-pnzngr mz da kc tqmcle.
Jiszs Adcpx-lzbqbz Mz Leplz Nede Nzling
Mz zbq lcde, leplz neng Jiszs nzling nzvzng mz mztea Zmezs. Mz mzlir Zmezs x Jerusalem, kilomita nzpnu-esz'-nrade-esz' (11).
Tzycmnetr-ngrdr da kcng amrlx tzwaisrngr Jiszs.
X mzli kc tzryapwx-etr-ngrdr, Jiszs adcpx-lzbqbz badr, sc tzvzpeng badr.
Nzmclr nide, a' mztr traopxpwzu Gct nzglx-krdr nide.
Rpibz Jiszs badr kx, “?Nila tqpiamu nzvz-krmu la?” Nztu-lrpitxng, nzobqmitxdr drtwr kxvz.
Kzdq nidr, drtqde Kleopas, veapebz bade, rpibzle kx, “?Ni-txpwzme ncblo kx mnc Jerusalem kx trkrlzleu da kc tqprtz elr mz zbq lcng trkqluu tqyrkrpxpe?”

Rpibzle kx, “?Nike lcdeng?” Nzrpibzlr kx, “Da kcng tzwaisrngr Jiszs kc Naszret. Ncblo lc nide profet kx ycmnemile zmatq x aleti da kxmatq, aelwapx-ngrde kx zmatq lc vzpxm mz Gct. X leplz amrlx nzamatqlr nide mz nabzdr.
A' kxnzetu rdr pris ngrgung x kxnzrmailzng, nzkaobzlr nide mz doa ngr gzpman ngr Rom kcng tzaclveng, murde nzrpilr nanibqlr nide mz nztqlvztr-krdrle mz kros.
Obqtipxkr kx nide Kxnzmcpx kc tqatwzlr-ngrm Gct mz nzarlapx-krde Israel. A' drtwrgr matxpe murde krlc zbq kratq mz nibr da kcng tqprtz.
Kxmule-esz', a' kzdung olvz mz dzbede kc tqprtr-ngrgr, nzakctitxpxlr nigr. Murde nzvzbzng mz butqbr kc mzli kcma mz nourla kxtopwz,
x trnzmcpelru nrkrdrtqde. Nzyzlumqng nzrpilr kx nzrmcng kzdq enjrl ne Gct kx pibzle badr kx Jiszs sa tqlu.
Kzdung kztegr nzvzng mz butqbr kc. X nzmclr naode obq x mznrngr, da kc tqwai nzpi-krbz olvz kcng le. A' trnzmclru Jiszs.”
Zbz rpibz Jiszs badr kx, “Asa-zlwzamu nzyrplatitrkr narmu da, x asa-zlwz-kzamu nzlxngiti-krmu da kcng amrlx tzyrolr profet kcng bqnc mz nzycmnetr-krdr mz Kxnzmcpx.
?Memule tropxu nzpipx-pnz-kaikr profet kcng le, kx drtqde naetq mz da lcng, x mz nibrde sc tqatulzpe Gct x tqamyalzpele nide Heven?”
X Jiszs kc tqyapwx-dalitipebzle badr ngalrde lcng amrlx tzycmnetr-ngrdr Kxnzmcpx mz Nzryrngrkxtr, abzole mz buk scng Mosis krlzbzle mz nzryrkr profet kcng amrlx.
Kx nzesotrpzlr mz mztea kc tzvzkilr, mrlx kc opxm kx navz-rlrupe.
A' nzrpibzlr kx, “Namncpeku, murde nrlc milzpqpe x ycpe pipz nrlc nzbq-krde.” Zbz sc tqvztrpebz tzmncpeng badr.
Zbz kx nzwxbulzlr badr mz tebol, otibzle bret, x sc tqkrka'lvzpele. Zbz lopxile bret x kabzle badr.
X mztr kc tqaopxpebz Gct nzglx-krdr nide, a' mzli lcpwz mrbrlqtxbz mz mztr.
X nzrpi-etrpelr kx, “Mzli kc tqycmne-ngrmle bagi mz lrpzki, drtwrgi elatxlzm nzyapwx-daliti-krmle Nzryrngrkxtr kcng. Aputxmle bagi zyzlr kx nakrlz-ngrgi da, a' trglx-pnzkiu nide.”
Nztulzmqng mzli kcpwz x nzyzlutx-moung Jerusalem, mz nzmc-krdr aposol kcng nzpnu-esz'-nrade-esz', tzyrlwr-lxblrng badr leplz neng Jiszs kc-kzng.
Nzrpipebzlr mz ncblo kcng nzling kx, “Kxetu rgu tutxlz-angidrpem mz nzbzngr. Aelwa-lzbqpe-ngrbz mz Saemon!”
Zbz ncblo kcng nzling nzpibzlr da kcng tqprtz mz lrpzki kc tqvzkile mztea Zmezs, x kxmu nzglx-krdr nide mzli kc tqlopxipe-ngrbzle bret nadr.
Jiszs Adcpx-lzbqbz Mz Leplz Nedeng
Mzli kcpwz ncblo kcng nzling tzpi-ngrpwzlr da lc, nzpwrkilvc-ngrdr Jiszs tutxpebz mz mzlirdr. Rpibzle badr kx, “Krka'-ngrne kx Gct na-amnc-zpwxle nimu.”
Leplz kcng amrlx nzmwxlrtx-pnzng, murde nzrpilr nzrmcpeng mqngr ncblo kxbz.
A' rpibz Jiszs kx, “?Memule tqmwxlr-ngrnamu? ?Memule tqlititrngr drtwrmu ninge?
Mcamu ena bzmr nilz kcng mz mqnge x nanycnge. Ninge lc! Maletrpa'mu ninge. Mqngr ncblo kxbz trpnzngr nrkrdrtqde, a' nrkrdrtqnge ycbz.”
Mz nibr nzpi-krbz Jiszs da lc, sc tqaelwape-ngrbzle mqdeng x nanycdeng.
Nzabrtz-krdr etu x mzlvztx naodr mz nzrkctipxngr da kc tzmclr. A' sc trnzlxngitikalr kx Jiszs kc angidr, tulzpem mz nzbzngr. Rpibz Jiszs badr kx, “?Rnginamu dakxnzng mrka?”
Nzkabzlr kc dapu nc kx nztqngq.
Otibzle x ngqbzle mz mztr, mz nzaelwapx-krbzle kx trnginideu mqngr.
Zbz rpibzle badr kx, “Da kcng ena lc tqpitibo mzli kc tqmncbe-ngrgu. Rpibo kx da kcng amrlx tzyrngr ninge mz Lou sc Mosis, mz nzryr-krdr profet, x mz Sam kcng, na-atutrng.”
Zbz aopxbzle mztr mz nzyrplatitrkr nardr Nzryrngrkxtr kcng tzyrngr Kxnzmcpx.
X sc tqrpipebzle badr kx, “Nzyr pnz kx drtq Kxnzmcpx naetq x nabz, x mz zbq kratq sc tqlupe mou.
X nrpa ngr nzrtekqtrngr drtwr x nzipqpxngr alwx, nayapwxtipxbz mz zmatq ngrde, na-abzo Jerusalem, sc tqkrlzpebzle mrkzbleng amrlx.
Mcamu nzale-krnge da lcng amrlx tqpingr Nzryrngrkxtr Kxnzmcpx. X mzli kape napipebzmu mz kzdu-kzng leplz da kcng tqmcamu, murde nalxngiti-kzlr ninge.
X sa na-atwzlr-ngrmc Mqngrkxtr kc tqesalzngr Trtenge. A' aenzlipwzmu Jerusalem, navz nakrlzbzle mzli kc navzo-ngrmle Heven mz nzmncpx-krmle bamu, murde narkabz bamu zmatq.”
Nzvzdzkr Jiszs Heven
Zbz sc tqmailzpxpeleng Jerusalem, nzvzng nzesotrpzng mztea kc Betzni. Mrlc mqdeng glalzbzleng badr sc tqamrlzpeleng.
X mzli lcpwz, sc tqavzdzpe Gct nide Heven.
Nzangiolr nide x sc tzyzlutrpe-moung Jerusalem. Nzabrtztx-atwrnr-ngrng.
X mzbq kang kqlu nzrmcti-lzbq-zvzng mz Mangr-nzangiongr tzawibzng mz Gct.

footnotes.text: Mz kzdung nzryrngr kcng pnz ngalrde 12 trnzyru elr. A' mc kz Jon 20:3-10.
24:36 Krlc kxmu nzrpi-krdr kx, “Nimu la.” 24:40 Ngalrde 40 trnzyru mz kzdung nzryrngr kcng pnz.
